photography_style.lighting: dramatic studio lighting, rim light, neon accents
photography_style.angle: 3/4 angle, exploded view for tech modules
photography_style.background: dark gradient or futuristic tech background
photography_style.detail_shots: ports, buttons, screen, internal components (exploded view)

prompt_templates.hero: Tech hero banner for {product_name}. Product floating or placed as hero on a dark gradient background with dramatic rim light and subtle neon glow. Cinematic composition, generous negative space, premium headline area left blank. {visual_style} aesthetic, tech magazine quality, 8K, no text overlay.
prompt_templates.tech: Technical visualization panel for {product_name}. Exploded view or transparent cutaway showing internal components and technology. Clean background, engineering-drawing aesthetic with ghosted labels (no actual text). Professional product engineering visualization.
prompt_templates.feature: Feature highlight panel for {product_name}. Close-up of a key feature (port, button, screen, camera) with dramatic lighting and shallow depth of field. Dark background, premium tech product photography, magazine-grade retouching.
prompt_templates.scenario: Tech lifestyle panel for {product_name}. Product naturally integrated into a modern desk or living setup, warm ambient lighting, minimal Scandinavian interior. Product as hero, hands-only or no human presence. Editorial tech lifestyle photography, {language} cultural context.
prompt_templates.spec_param: Specification dashboard panel for {product_name}. Clean infographic layout with rounded rectangles, thin iconography, {brand_color} accents, and product peeking from one side. Professional data visualization style, placeholder layout, no actual text.
prompt_templates.core_selling: Benefit panel for {product_name}. Product + 3-4 visualized selling points (speed, battery, durability, smart features) arranged as clean graphic blocks. {visual_style} aesthetic, modern tech brand layout, {language} market. No dense text.
prompt_templates.detail: Craft detail panel for {product_name}. Macro shot of surface finish, hinge, mesh, or connector. Crisp reflections, directional light, shallow depth of field. Premium material quality visible, no text.
prompt_templates.cta: Final conversion panel for {product_name}. Bold tech layout: product hero + glowing CTA block + trust badges. Dark gradient background, {brand_color} accents. No text.

copywriting.selling_point_style: technical + benefit-driven, specs-first then emotional payoff
